entities.name: EPS Bearer Context
entities.description: An EPS bearer context represents a data flow with specific quality of service parameters. Each EPS bearer context maintains its own individual state.

entities.name: UE Side State
entities.description: The state maintained by the UE for an EPS bearer context, tracking its activation, modification, or deactivation status.

entities.name: Network Side State
entities.description: The state maintained by the network for an EPS bearer context, synchronized with the UE side state for proper data flow management.

relations.description: Each EPS bearer context maintains an individual state on the UE side.
Each EPS bearer context maintains an individual state on the network side.
